title: Ideal H1 vanishing implies H1 vanishing for finite free kernels
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] such that H¹(X,J)=0 for every quasi-coherent ideal sheaf J⊆O_X [pqf-def-coherent, pqf-def-cohomology]. For every finite index type I and every O_X-linear map p: O_X^(I) → O_X, the kernel F of p satisfies H¹(X,F)=0. No surjectivity of p, cover, quasi-compactness, or affineness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 01XF, label lemma-quasi-compact-h1-zero-covering, kernel filtration paragraph; its filtration argument does not require the map to be surjective

proof.text: Apply finite_free_kernel_ideal_filtration to obtain a finite chain F starting at an IsZero object, ending in an object isomorphic to kernel p, and short exact sequences F_j → F_(j+1) → J_j.toModules with each J_j.toModules quasi-coherent. This is the geometric coordinate-filtration part of the source argument, independent of the ideal H¹ hypothesis.

Let H be moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1 and Γ be globalSectionsFunctor. H is additive, so it maps the zero initial object to zero. Induct on j ≤ n. The full long exact sequence for the j-th short exact sequence yields exactness of H(F_j) → H(F_(j+1)) → H(J_j.toModules). The induction hypothesis annihilates the first object, and the given ideal hypothesis annihilates the last. Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_isZero annihilates the middle.

Map the endpoint isomorphism F_n ≅ kernel p by H. Transport the IsZero conclusion along its inverse and apply ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero. The induction includes n = 0 without requiring a nonempty index type or an epimorphic p.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01XF, coordinate-filtration paragraph and following H¹ induction; M2 formalizes the cohomological induction, isolating the geometric chain as its own theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_free_kernel_h1_zero (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hI : ∀ (I : X.IdealSheafData), I.toModules.IsQuasicoherent →
      Subsingleton ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I.toModules))
    {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (p : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶
      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :
    Subsingleton ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj (kernel p))
